name: Gregory the Great
bio:
Prefect of Rome who became a monk, then papal envoy at Constantinople, and from 590 Bishop of Rome; he sent Augustine's mission to England and reformed the Church's worship and care of the poor.

His Morals on the Book of Job (Moralia in Job), begun as talks to his fellow monks in Constantinople, reads Job verse by verse in three senses, historical, allegorical and moral; it was among the most read books of the Middle Ages. He is honoured as a saint and Doctor of the Church in East and West.
